blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House lead prosecutor and Batangas Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” Luistro on Friday expressed disappointment over the defense strategy of Vice President Sara Duterte, saying her lawyers have so far focused on minor expenditures rather than directly addressing the core allegations of unexplained wealth. Speaking after the first week of the defense’s presentation in Duterte’s impeachment trial, Luistro noted that the respondent’s camp only presented witnesses to testify on two undeclared real properties, nearly P70,000 in compensation from the Davao City government, a dinner bill exceeding P200,000, and P256,000 worth of sneakers. “They are testifying on the very small […]...
